levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Spot is chosen with no stated reason.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: States a plausible reason tied to how or where the item is used.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reasoning compares at least two possible spots and explains why one wins.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than three of five items are returned to their home the next day.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least four of five items are returned correctly.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All five are returned, and the learner diagnoses the cause when one drifts.

lookFors: Homes are specific locations, not general rooms.
Learner, not the adult, makes the final placement decision on day two.
Reflection names one concrete reason, not just 'I forgot.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
